sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and financial sectors are surging into "all-green" status, while Utilities experiences a sharp decline in rank.

A powerful rotation is underway as defensive and financial sectors capture leadership. Four out of eleven groups—Financial, Healthcare, Real Estate, and Consumer Defensive—are currently "all-green," showing positive performance across the weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD timeframes. While Energy remains the absolute momentum leader with a score of 0.800 and holds the rank 1 spot, Technology is close behind with a momentum score of 0.617 at rank 2.

In contrast, Utilities has suffered a severe drop, falling 4 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 9, accompanied by a weak momentum score of 0.233. Industrials is also fading, slipping 1 spot to rank 4 with momentum declining to 0.350. Consumer Cyclical remains anchored at the bottom of the YTD rankings (rank 11) with the lowest momentum score in the market at 0.217.

## Strength
* **Broad-Based Strength:** 4 of 11 market groups are currently "all-green," demonstrating positive performance across all measured time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).
* **Financials Lead the All-Green Pack:** Financial is the strongest of the all-green sectors, carrying a momentum score of 0.72 (rank 7).
* **Defensive and Real Estate Support:** Healthcare (momentum 0.62, rank 8), Real Estate (momentum 0.62, rank 3), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.57, rank 6) round out the list of fully positive sectors.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Energy Holds the Top Spot:** Energy remains the strongest momentum leader with a score of 0.800, maintaining its rank 1 position YTD.
* **Widespread Minor Rank Gains:** Five sectors improved their rank by +1 spot over the last 5 sessions: Basic Materials (to rank 5, momentum 0.52), Consumer Defensive (to rank 6, momentum 0.57), Financial (to rank 7, momentum 0.72), Healthcare (to rank 8, momentum 0.62), and Real Estate (to rank 3, momentum 0.62).
* **Utilities Plummet:** Utilities is the week's biggest decliner, dropping 4 spots to rank 9 with a weak momentum score of 0.233.
* **Persistent Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.217, rank 11) and Communication Services (momentum 0.250, rank 10) failed to make any ranking progress over the last 5 sessions.

## Divergences
* **High Momentum vs. Low YTD Rank:** Financial (momentum 0.717, rank 7) and Healthcare (momentum 0.617, rank 8) exhibit strong short-term momentum despite their lower YTD ranks, signaling a powerful recent rotation.
* **High YTD Rank vs. Fading Momentum:** Industrials sits at YTD rank 4 but exhibits a weak momentum score of 0.350, highlighting a significant negative divergence from its longer-term trend.
* **No Fragile All-Green Signals:** There are currently no active fragile all-green divergences registered in the system data.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Market breadth remains moderate with 37 of 144 groups in all-green territory, led by dominant energy and steel segments, while consumer discretionary and travel-related services stage sharp short-term recoveries.

Heavy industry and energy continue to anchor the market's core strength, with Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing and Steel sustaining their top-tier momentum. However, a notable rotation is underway as consumer discretionary and travel segments surge. Luxury Goods (+24 spots) and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+21 spots) led the week's rank improvements, alongside solid gains in Travel Services and Airlines, signaling a sudden revival in consumer-facing industries.

Conversely, defensive and industrial-adjacent groups are fading. Building Products & Equipment plummeted 20 spots, while Aluminum and Integrated Freight & Logistics also experienced sharp weekly declines. Early-warning signals point to fatigue in previously resilient areas like REIT - Healthcare Facilities and Diagnostics & Research, which are losing rank despite holding relatively high momentum.

## Strength
* **Core Leaders:** 37 out of 144 industry groups maintain "all-green" status across all timeframes. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.91) and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.88) lead this resilient pack.
* **Sustained Performance:** Cyclical and financial groups show the most robust long-term trends, with Steel, Staffing & Employment Services, Financial Conglomerates, Insurance - Life, and Banks - Diversified consistently ranking in the top 36 over 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
* **Consumer & Real Estate Anchors:** REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.83) and Department Stores (momentum 0.80) remain firmly in the all-green category, highlighting pockets of durable consumer-facing strength.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Luxury Goods led the weekly rank improvement, jumping 24 spots to rank 54 (momentum 0.72), followed closely by Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+21 spots to rank 81) and Education & Training Services (+20 spots to rank 71).
* **Sharp Decliners:** Building Products & Equipment suffered the largest weekly drop, falling 20 spots to rank 61 (momentum 0.32). Aluminum (-19 spots to rank 90) and Integrated Freight & Logistics (-18 spots to rank 49) also saw severe momentum deterioration.
* **Deep Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.11) and Utilities - Independent Power Producers (momentum 0.12) remain anchored at the bottom of the market's momentum spectrum.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Several high-momentum industries are beginning to slip in rank, led by REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.68, dropping 8 spots) and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.63, dropping 7 spots), indicating potential exhaustion.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Lower-momentum groups are quietly climbing the ranks, led by Specialty Business Services (up 7 spots, momentum 0.49), Restaurants (up 6 spots, momentum 0.46), and Real Estate Services (up 5 spots, momentum 0.42).
